lessons_learned.title: Agent Configuration Loading Issue
lessons_learned.problem: Agents were stuck in TN (stopped) state, no videos created
lessons_learned.root_cause: autonomous_learning_agent.py didn't properly load custom config files
symptoms: Config files created but not loaded
lessons_learned.solution: Need to add config loading logic in autonomous_learning_agent.py main() function
lessons_learned.code_pattern:
# BEFORE (broken):
def main():
    agent = AutonomousLearningAgent()
    # Config never loaded!

# AFTER (working):
def main():
    args = parser.parse_args()
    agent = AutonomousLearningAgent()
    
    # Load custom config if provided
    if args.config:
        import json
        with open(args.config, 'r') as f:
            custom_config = json.load(f)
            if 'patterns' in custom_config:
                agent.training_scenarios = custom_config['patterns']
lessons_learned.lesson: Always verify config loading works BEFORE spawning multiple processes

lessons_learned.title: Testing Before Deployment
lessons_learned.problem: Launched 4 agents without testing if one works
lessons_learned.root_cause: Assumed code would work without validation
lessons_learned.solution: Always test with 1 agent first, then scale up
lessons_learned.lesson: Test small, then scale. Don't assume.

lessons_learned.title: Simplicity Over Complexity
lessons_learned.problem: Complex orchestrator with 4 agents, configs, patterns - too many moving parts
lessons_learned.root_cause: Tried to do everything at once
lessons_learned.code_pattern:
# COMPLEX (breaks easily):
- Master orchestrator
- 4 different agents
- Config files for each
- Pattern library loading
- Custom scenario injection
= Too many failure points!

# SIMPLE (reliable):
class SimpleAgent:
    def __init__(self):
        self.maker = RealisticMovieMaker()
        self.scenarios = [5 hardcoded scenarios]
    
    def create_one_video(self):
        scenario = random.choice(self.scenarios)
        self.maker.create_movie(scenario['story'], name)
        
= Works every time!
lessons_learned.lesson: Start simple. Add complexity only when simple version works perfectly.

lessons_learned.title: Method Name Mismatch
lessons_learned.problem: autonomous_learning_agent calls video_maker.create_video() but integrated_smart_video_maker doesn't have that method
lessons_learned.root_cause: Assumed method names without checking API
lessons_learned.solution: Check actual API of classes before calling
lessons_learned.code_pattern:
# WRONG (assumed):
video_maker.create_video(text=story)

# RIGHT (actual API):
# Check realistic_movie_maker.py:
def create_movie(self, story_text, output_name):
    # This is the real method!

# So use:
video_maker.create_movie(story, video_name)
lessons_learned.lesson: Never assume method names. Always check the actual class definition.

lessons_learned.title: Auto-Cleanup Logic
lessons_learned.problem: Training videos accumulate, user wants automatic deletion
lessons_learned.code_pattern:
def cleanup_old_videos(self):
    video_files = list(workspace.glob('training_video*.mp4'))
    video_count = len(video_files)
    
    if video_count > self.cleanup_threshold:
        # Sort by modification time (oldest first)
        video_files.sort(key=lambda x: x.stat().st_mtime)
        
        # Keep newest N videos
        to_delete = video_count - self.max_training_videos
        
        for video_file in video_files[:to_delete]:
            video_file.unlink()  # Delete
            
        log.info(f'Deleted {to_delete} old videos')
lessons_learned.lesson: Automate maintenance tasks. Don't let system fill up.

lessons_learned.title: Background Music Replaced Narration
lessons_learned.problem: Videos lose narration because merge_audio_video concatenates tracks instead of mixing them, so ffmpeg keeps only the shorter segment.
symptoms: Final MP4 contains background tone but narration stops early
Rahbar reports video duration shorter than script
lessons_learned.root_cause: pydub concatenation with combined += audio builds a sequential playlist. Background music never overlaps narration, and ffmpeg drops extra length.
lessons_learned.solution: Use AudioSegment.overlay to place the music bed under the spoken track, normalise levels, and trim/loop music to the total scene duration before muxing in ffmpeg.
lessons_learned.code_pattern:
# WRONG (current)
combined = AudioSegment.empty()
for audio in audio_files:
    combined += audio  # plays one after another

# RIGHT (mix)
voice = AudioSegment.silent(duration=target_ms)
for segment in voice_tracks:
    voice = voice.overlay(segment, position=segment_start)

music = build_music_track(target_ms)
final_mix = voice.overlay(music - 12)
lessons_learned.lesson: Whenever multiple audio elements must play together, mix with overlay instead of concatenation.

lessons_learned.title: Raw Training Photos Should Guide Style, Not Become Actors
lessons_learned.problem: Rendered videos showed a still portrait sliding across the screen because draw_realistic_character pasted the source photo for every frame.
lessons_learned.root_cause: RealisticRenderer treated training_photos as live sprites. As the animation moved left-to-right, the same photograph drifted, breaking immersion and repeating real family photos.
symptoms: Character visuals reuse the exact training photo
No arm/leg animation – just a static picture gliding
Story roles (mother, kid, granthi) ignore dialogue context
lessons_learned.solution: Disable photo overlays by default, keep photos for background ambience, and drive character selection through diverse_character_generator using scene role heuristics (prepare_for_scene + _select_character_template).
lessons_learned.code_pattern:
# WRONG: direct photo overlay every frame
if self.use_real_photos:
    img.paste(bordered_photo, position)

# RIGHT: map scene label to generator template
self.prepare_for_scene(character_name)
self.current_character = self._select_character_template(label)
self.char_generator.draw_character(...)
lessons_learned.lesson: Training photos should inspire style palettes; let animated characters act the story so the user's images stay private.

lessons_learned.title: Real Stories Need Real Actors, Voices, and Mood
lessons_learned.problem: Videos still look like simple cartoons. Characters do not act the story, backgrounds ignore location, and audio never matches age or emotion.
lessons_learned.root_cause: Pipeline lacks a story-to-scene planner, motion-capable character generator, role-based voice casting, and mood-aware music selection.
symptoms: Every scene reuses generic walking loop regardless of action
Dialog is single voice per scene, no speaker differentiation
Background photo chosen randomly instead of story setting
Music is same sine tone even for happy/sad/adventure
lessons_learned.solution: Design a cinematic pipeline: parse narrative into structured beats, generate per-character motion visuals (LoRA/AnimateDiff), cast voices by age+gender, and select/compose music cues from mood metadata. Provide Rahbar with a phased training plan covering planner, visuals, audio, and QA.
lessons_learned.lesson: Rahbar must think like a film unit: plan scene→cast→motion→audio, then render.
